text: Aleph. Blessed are those that be perfect in the way: walkyng in the lawe of God.
Blessed are they that kepe his testimonies: they seke hym with their whole heart.
Truely they walke in his wayes: who do no wickednesse.
Thou hast geuen charge: that we shoulde diligently kepe thy commaundementes.
I wishe that my wayes were directed: for to kepe thy statutes.
I shall take then no shame: when I haue regarde vnto all thy commaundementes.
I wyll confesse it vnto thee with an vpryght heart: when I shall haue learned the iudgementes of thy ryghteousnesse.
I wyll kepe thy statutes: wherfore forsake me not for any long tyme.
Beth Wherby shall a young man refourme his way: euen in guiding it accordyng to thy worde.
I haue sought thee with my whole heart: suffer me not to swarue from thy commaundementes.
I haue hyd thy wordes within my heart: for this ende, that I shoulde not sinne agaynst thee.
Blessed art thou O God: teache me thy statutes.
I haue declared with my lyppes: all the iudgementes of thy mouth.
I am delighted in the way of thy testimonies: as in all maner of riches.
I wyll study thy commaundementes: and I wyll consider thy wayes.
My delyght shalbe in thy statutes: and I wyll not forget thy worde.
Gimel Rewarde thy seruaunt, let me lyue: and I wyll kepe thy worde.
Open thou myne eyes: and I will beholde the wonderous thynges of thy lawe.
I am a straunger vpon earth: hyde not thy commaundementes from me.
My soule faynteth: for the very feruent desire that it hath alwaye vnto thy iudgementes.
Thou hast rebuked those that be proude and cursed: who do erre from thy commaundementes.
Withdrawe from me reproche and contempt: for that I haue kept thy testimonies.
Yea princes dyd syt and speake agaynst me: but thy seruaunt did geue hym selfe to the meditation of thy statutes.
Yea thy testimonies are my delyght: and my counsaylers.
Daleth My soule cleaueth to the dust: reuiue thou me accordyng to thy worde.
I haue made a declaration to thee of my wayes, and thou heardest me: O teache me thy statutes.
Make me to vnderstande the way of thy commaundementes: and I wyll geue my selfe to the meditation of thy wonderous workes.
My soule melteth away for very heauinesse: comfort thou me accordyng to thy worde.
Take from me the way of falshood: & witsafe me worthy to haue thy lawe.
I haue chosen the way of trueth: & I haue layde thy iudgementes before me.
I haue stuck fast vnto thy testimonies: O God confounde me not.
I wyll runne the way of thy commaundementes: when thou shalt set my heart at libertie.
He Teache me O God the way of thy statutes: and I wyll kepe it vnto the ende.
Geue me vnderstanding, & I wil kepe thy law: yea I wyll kepe it with my whole heart.
Leade me in the path of thy comaundementes: for therin is my delyght.
Encline myne heart vnto thy testimonies: and not to couetousnesse.
Turne away myne eyes, lest they beholde vanitie: cause me to lyue in thy way.
Make thy worde more euident vnto thy seruaunt: who is geuen to thy feare.
Take away the reproche that I am afraide of: for thy iudgemetes are good.
Behold I haue coueted after thy commaundementes: cause me to lyue in thy ryghteousnesse.
Vau Let thy louing mercie also come vnto me O God: euen thy saluation, accordyng to thy worde.
And I shall aunswere to hym that layeth thy worde to me for a reproche: for in thy worde I haue put my trust.
Take not the worde of trueth vtterly out of my mouth: for my hope is in thy iudgementes.
And I wyll alway kepe thy lawe: yea for euer and euer.
And I wyll walke in a large scope: for I seke thy commaundementes.
I wyll also speake of thy testimonies before kinges: & I will not be ashamed.
And my delyght shalbe in thy commaundementes: which I haue loued.
And I wyll lyft vp my handes vnto thy commaundementes which I haue loued: & my study shalbe in thy statutes.
Zain Be myndfull of thy promise made vnto thy seruaunt: wherin thou hast caused me to put my trust.
That same is my comfort in my affliction: for thy worde maketh me to lyue.
The proude haue had me exceedingly in derision: yet I haue not shrinked from thy lawe.
For I called to remembraunce thy iudgementes from the begynnyng of the worlde O God: and so I comforted my selfe.
An extreme vnnaturall heat hath assayled me, because of the vngodly: who transgresse thy lawe.
Thy statutes haue ben my songes: in the house of my pilgrimages.
I haue thought vpon thy name O God in the nyght season: and I haue kept thy lawe.
This came to passe for me: because I kept thy commaundementes.
Heth Thou art my portion O God: I haue purposed to kepe thy lawe.
I made myne humble petition to thy face with my whole heart: be mercifull vnto me according vnto thy word.
I haue considered mine owne wayes: and I haue turned my feete vnto thy testimonies.
I made haste and I made no delay: for to kepe thy commaundementes.
The vngodly haue tangled me in their snares: but I haue not forgotten thy lawe.
I wyll ryse at midnight to confesse me vnto thee: because of thy ryghteous iudgementes.
I am a companion of all them that feare thee: and kepe thy commaundementes.
The earth O God is replenished with thy louyng kyndnesse: O teache me thy statutes.
Teth O God thou hast dealt gratiouslye with thy seruaunt: according vnto thy worde.
Learne me the good taste & cunning: for I haue beleued thy commaundementes.
Before I felt affliction I swarued out of the way: but nowe I kepe thy word.
Thou art good and beneficiall: teache me thy statutes.
The proude haue forged a false tale agaynst me: but I wyll kepe thy commaundementes with my whole heart.
Their heart is as fat as brawne: but my delyght hath ben in thy lawe.
It is good for me that I am brought into miserie: by that meanes I shall learne thy statutes.
The lawe of thy mouth is dearer vnto me: then thousandes of golde & siluer.
Iod Thy handes haue made me and fashioned me: geue me vnderstanding, and I will learne thy comaundementes.
They that feare thee, shall see me, & reioyce: because I haue geuen earnest attendaunce vnto thy worde.
I know O God that thy iudgementes are iustice: and that thou hast caused me ryghtfully to be afflicted.
I beseche thee let thy louing kindnesse be a meanes to comfort me: accordyng to thy worde spoken vnto thy seruaunt.
Let thy pitifull mercies come vnto me, that I may lyue: for thy lawe is my delyght.
Let the proude be confounded, for they haue falsly reported me: but I wyll study thy commaundementes.
Let such as feare thee and knowe thy testimonies: returne vnto me.
Let myne heart be perfectly set in thy statutes: that I be not ashamed.
Caph My soule hath faynted after thy saluation: I geue earnest attedaunce vnto thy worde.
Myne eyes haue faynted after thy worde: whylest I say, when wilt thou comfort me.
For I am become like a bottel hanged in the smoke: yet I do not forget thy statutes.
Howe many are the dayes of thy seruaunt? when wilt thou geue iudgement agaynst them that persecute me?
The proude haue digged pittes for me: which is a thing not done accordyng to thy lawe.
All thy commaundementes are the trueth it selfe: they wrongfully persecute me, O be thou my ayde.
They had almost made an ende of me vpon the earth: but I forsoke not thy commaundementes.
Make me to lyue accordyng to thy pietie: and I wyll kepe the testimonies of thy mouth.
Lamed O God: thy worde endureth for euer in heauen.
Thy trueth appeareth to euery generation: thou hast layde the foundation of the earth, and it shall continue.
All thynges continue this day accordyng to thine ordinaunce: for all thinges be thy seruauntes.
If my delight had not ben in thy lawe: I shoulde haue perished in myne affliction.
I wyll neuer forget thy commaundementes: for through them thou hast reuiued me.
I am thine, saue me: for I haue diligently studied thy commaundementes ouer.
When the vngodly layde wayte for me to destroy me: I endeuoured my selfe to vnderstande thy testimonies.
I see an ende of euery thing be it neuer so perfect: but thy commaundement is exceedyng large.
Mem Howe greatly do I loue thy lawe? my study is all the day long in it.
Thou hast made me wyser then myne enemies through thy commaundementes: for they are euer with me.
I am able to geue better instruction then all they that were my teachers: for thy testimonies are my study.
I am made to vnderstande more then the aged can: because I kept thy commaundementes.
I haue rstrayned my feete from euery euyll way: that I may kepe thy worde.
I haue not shrinked from thy iudgementes: for thou didst teache me.
Howe sweete are thy wordes vnto my throte: truely they be sweeter then hony is to my mouth.
Through thy commaundementes I get vnderstandyng: therfore I hate all wayes of falshood.
Nun Thy worde is a candell vnto my feete: and a lyght vnto my pathes.
I haue made an oth (which I wil ratifie) for to kepe thy iuste iudgementes.
I am troubled aboue measure: quicken me O God accordyng vnto thy worde.
Let the freewyll offerynges of my mouth please thee O God: and teache me thy iudgementes.
My soule is alway in my hande: yet I do not forget thy lawe.
The vngodly haue layde a snare for me: but yet I swarued not from thy commaundementes.
I haue claymed thy testimonies as myne heritage for euer: for they are the very ioy of myne heart.
I haue applyed myne heart for to fulfyll thy statutes: euen to the worldes ende.
Samech I hate hygh subtile deuices: and I do loue thy lawe.
Thou art my refuge and my shield: I geue earnest attendaunce vnto thy worde.
Auoyde from me ye malicious persons: and I wyll kepe the commaundementes of my Lorde.
Strengthen me in thy worde and I shall lyue: and make me not ashamed of my hope.
Holde thou me vp and I shalbe safe: and I will loke gladly vpon thy statutes alwayes.
Thou hast troden vnder foote all them that go astray from thy statutes: for their crafty deuice is but falshood.
Thou hast dispatched out of the way all the vngodly of the earth lyke drosse: therfore I loue thy testimonies.
My fleshe trembleth for feare of thee: and I am afrayde of thy iudgementes.
Ain I haue executed iudgement and iustice: wherfore leaue me not to such as do offer me wrong.
For thy owne goodnesse sake take thy seruaunt vnto thy protection: let not the proude oppresse me with wrong.
Myne eyes haue faynted with lokyng for thy saluation: and for the worde of thy ryghteousnesse.
Deale with thy seruaunt accordyng vnto thy owne louyng kyndnesse: and teache me thy statutes.
I am thy seruaunt, graunt me vnderstandyng: that I may knowe thy testimonies.
It is tyme for me to do for Gods cause: for they haue brought thy lawe almost to nothyng.
Therfore I loue thy commaundementes: aboue golde and precious stone.
Therfore I take all thy commaundementes euery one of them to be ryght: & I vtterly hate all wayes of falshood.
Pe Thy testimonies contayne wonderfull thinges: therfore doth my soule kepe them.
The first entering of thy wordes will illuminate: geuyng vnderstanding euen vnto the simple.
I opened my mouth and panted: for I bare a great affection to thy commaundementes.
Loke thou vpon me and be mercifull vnto me: as thou vsest to do vnto those that loue thy name.
Direct my steppes in thy worde: and so shall no wickednesse haue dominion ouer me.
Redeeme me from the fraudulent dealyng of men: and I wyll kepe thy commaundementes.
Make the lyght of thy countenaunce shyne vpon thy seruaunt: and teache me thy statutes.
Ryuers of waters gushe out of myne eyes: because men kepe not thy lawe.
Sade O God: thou art iust and vpryght in thy iudgementes.
Thou hast commaunded the iustice and the veritie of thy testimonies: to be obserued very strayghtly.
My zeale hath consumed me: because myne aduersaries haue forgotten thy wordes.
Thy worde is purified to the vttermost: and thy seruaunt loueth it.
I am small and of no reputation: yet I do not forget thy comaundementes.
Thy ryghteousnesse is an euerlastyng righteousnesse: & thy lawe is the trueth.
Trouble and griefe haue taken holde vpon me: yet thy commaundementes be my delyght.
The righteousnesse of thy testimonies is euerlastyng: make me to vnderstande them and I shall lyue.
Coph I haue called with my whole heart, heare me O God: I wyll kepe thy statutes.
I haue called vpon thee, saue me: and I wyll kepe thy testimonies.
I haue preuented other in the dawnyng of the day, and I cryed vnto thee: for I geue earnest attendaunce vnto thy wordes.
Myne eyes haue preuented the nyght watches: that my study might be wholy in thy wordes.
Heare my voyce accordyng to thy louing kindnesse: make me to lyue O God after thy iudgementes.
They that mynde to do an act of mischiefenesse, do drawe nye vnto me: they are farre from thy lawe.
But thou art nye at hande O God: and all thy comaundementes be trueth.
As concernyng thy testimonies: I haue knowen long since that thou hast made them to last for euer.
Resh Beholde myne affliction & deliuer me: for I haue not forgotten thy lawe.
Defende thou my cause & redeeme me: make me to lyue accordyng vnto thy worde.
Saluation is farre from the vngodly: for they study not thy statutes.
Thy mercies be manifolde O God: make me to liue accordyng to thy iudgementes.
There be many that do persecute me and be myne aduersaries: yet I do not swarue from thy testimonies.
I sawe transgressours, and I was greeued at the heart: because they kept not thy lawe.
Beholde howe I loue thy commaundementes: quicken me O God accordyng to thy louyng kindnesse.
The beginning of thy word is trueth: and all the iudgementes of thy ryghteousnesse endure for euermore.
Shin Princes haue persecuted me without a cause: but my heart hath stoode in awe of thy wordes.
I am as glad of thy worde: as he that fyndeth a great bootie.
That which is false I hate and abhorre: but thy lawe I do loue.
I do prayse thee seuen tymes euery day: for loue of the iudgementes of thy iustice.
They that loue thy lawe shall haue great prosperitie: and nothyng shall offende them.
Lorde, I haue wayted after thy saluation: and I haue done thy commaundementes.
My soule hath kept thy testimonies: and I haue loued them exceedyngly.
I haue kept thy commaundementes and testimonies: for all my wayes are before thee.
Tau Let my crye O God approche neare vnto thy face: make me to vnderstande euery thyng accordyng vnto thy worde.
Let my supplication come before thee: deliuer me accordyng to thy worde.
My lippes shall powre out thy prayse: when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
My tongue shall syng of thy worde: for all thy commaundementes are ryghteousnesse.
Let thyne hande be redie for to ayde me: for I haue chosen thy commaundementes.
I haue longed for thy saluation O God: and thy lawe is my whole delight
Let my soule lyue, and it shall prayse thee: and thy iudgementes shalbe an ayde vnto me.
I haue gone astray lyke a lost sheepe: oh seke out thy seruaunt, for I haue not forgotten thy commaundementes.
